parameters.name: availability_zone
parameters.description: Specifies the AZ to which the subnet belongs. Cannot be changed after creating the subnet.

parameters.name: cidr
parameters.description: Specifies the subnet CIDR block. The value must be within the VPC CIDR block and be in CIDR format. The subnet mask cannot be greater than 28. Cannot be changed after creating the subnet.

parameters.name: dhcp_enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether DHCP is enabled for the subnet. The value can be true (enabled) or false(disabled), and default value is true. If this parameter is set to false, newly created ECSs cannot obtain IP addresses, and usernames and passwords cannot be injected using Cloud-init. Choices: false true

parameters.name: dns_address
parameters.description: Specifies the DNS server addresses for subnet. The address in the head is used first.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: gateway_ip
parameters.description: Specifies the gateway of the subnet. The value must be an IP address in the subnet. Cannot be changed after creating the subnet.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies the subnet name. The value is a string of 1 to 64 characters that can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeouts
parameters.description: The timeouts for each operations. Default: {}

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the VPC to which the subnet belongs. Cannot be changed after creating the subnet.

examples:
# create subnet
- name: Create vpc
  hwc_network_vpc:
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/24"
    name: "ansible_network_vpc_test"
  register: vpc
- name: Create subnet
  community.general.hwc_vpc_subnet:
    vpc_id: "{{ vpc.id }}"
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/26"
    gateway_ip: "192.168.100.32"
    name: "ansible_network_subnet_test"
    dhcp_enable: true

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: Specifies the AZ to which the subnet belongs. Returned: success
